svg.text: Sober native Linux port — FULL diagnosis map
Tracked files: 1009 (src 137, analysis 212, docs 49, tests 17, tools 2, build 441, other 151)
Ledger: 40 entries · DEBT=42 PROVEN=96 UNPROVEN=45 RETRACTED=26 BLOCKED=4 (keyword hits)
REVIEW-100 weighted score: 57% (older audit) · README current estimate: ≈66%
Guest engine: 559 exports / 573 imports (external, frozen, not redistributed) · JNI table: 231 slots
Marker: WITHHELD · rung1 = PASS-BOUNDARY-REPLAY (DEBT=1) · input w11-arg0.json SHA 8215519f
green = verified/implemented · blue = evidence/docs · orange = generated/required/debt · red = blocked/retracted · gray = no claim

g.title: Repository inventory: 1009 tracked files, one square each

rect.title: A1 Original goal and decisions 000–038: Infrastructure partial at goal level: **NOT DELIVERED** (0%)
A2 Native build / hard constraints: **≈90%**; bit-identical reproducible ELFs, libc-only ldd, frozen identity; gaps are automation/hygiene (90%)
A3 Guest init / relocs / allocator / TSD: **≈88%**; 565,390 relocations, 3,614 default ctors + explicit arena/thread init, signal/TSD shim; ctor[0] still opt-in (88%)
A4 Native render: **≈55%**; native frame proven, guest frame 0%; `render_ok` set by our own swap (55%)
A5 JNI bridge: Default 74/231 = 32% faithful; even with opt-ins 138/231 slots stay stubs; 22/49 cached IDs are placeholders; provenance recorder was dead code (now fixed) (32%)
A6 App state: **≈37%**; root causes ~90% mapped, env-free realized state ~20%, admissible evidence 0% (37%)
A7 Genuine callback: Static chain fully mapped, runtime occurrence **0%**; no notifier hit, placeId, or RA pair ever observed (0%)
A8 Strict gate: Gate upheld, no live false-green; all Tier‑1/2 mutators withheld; provenance required by policy but not positively coded (0%)
A9 Tests / verification: **≈57%** intent, **≈15%** CI-gated; strict test correctly RED (57%)
A10 Documentation: **≈67%**; honest but numerically stale and internally inconsistent (67%)
A11 Delivery: **≈80%**; private repo synced at `afed56d`; single squashed root commit (80%)
A12 File / binary inventory: 680 tracked files, 124,314 text lines, 78 binaries; source clean, 387 generated `build/` files committed (0%)
A13 Roadmap: Nine blockers, 25 effort units to 100% (100%)
A14 Honesty / false-green: Core posture sound, but several public facts stale — not safe to publish as-is until fixed (0%)
